name: fusion
description: Nested multi-agent coding swarm + multi-model council for Kimi Code / AndrewCode. Architect (Fable 5.1 / Astra gpt-6-astra) designs a custom hive; captains are any live CLI; nested workers are real AndrewCode processes on one Hive Board (WAL sqlite + JSONL, no daemon).
skillInstructions: Fusion is dormant until the user invokes /fusion:* (or /fusion:hive, /fusion:designer, /fusion:board, /fusion:metaloop). Do not auto-dispatch paid CLIs. Nested hive workers are real AndrewCode processes; never simulate them. Absent ≠ agreement. Resolve FUSION_PLUGIN_ROOT from this plugin's skills/ directory (two levels above skills/fusion-orchestrate/SKILL.md).

interface.shortDescription: Nested AndrewCode hives and multi-model councils for Kimi / AndrewCode.
interface.longDescription: Fusion conducts live coding CLIs (Codex, OpenCode/GLM, Grok, Copilot, Kimi, AndrewCode/Muse) from Kimi Code / AndrewCode. Hive: an architect (Fable 5.1 / Astra) may design a custom nested swarm; captains are any live CLI; nested workers are real AndrewCode processes talking on one Hive Board (WAL sqlite + JSONL, no daemon). Also panel, council, debate, vote, swarm, MoA, heavy, graph, ladder, breaker, ballot, MetaLoop.
